title: When Franchisee Service Affects Demand: An Application to the Car Radiator Market and Resale Price Maintenance
eligible_reason: Structural demand model with unobserved franchisee service effort (logit and random-coefficient GMM) for car radiators, with resale price maintenance counterfactuals. No DiD.
design_notes: FranchiseeEffortMain.m: homogeneous logit then random-coefficient GMM demand, second-step effort estimation, bootstrap SEs; Counterfactuals/CF_final.m.
data_files_note: readme.txt: actual data under NDA; artificial data drawn from the marginal distributions of each variable.
screener_notes: No article text or PDF available locally (data/text and papers/ checked Nov 2); the OpenAlex abstract in data/frame/mksc.jsonl is a one-sentence summary or empty. Design read from the README and the main-results code; no package code was run.
